title: Growai
body:
"The Growai is a mysterious plant with magical properties, its abilities yet to be fully understood."

Description

The Growai is a decorative item that can be found on the second floor of Flora Laura's in the Flowering Meadows. The Growai will be right next to the roses, with the top of the Growai only just barely visible and looks like a small bushy weed. It is one of several of the various types of Moai.
